notes: New Variant Types: reusable modifier groups (Temperature, Roast/Bean Type, Base Milk, Syrups & Sauces, Toppings, Texture Extras) alongside built-in Sizes — all collapsible in one list. Groups support single/multi-select and required selections, enforced at the POS before an item can be added. Choices can link to raw materials with a quantity, so selected modifiers deduct inventory at payment in both online and standalone mode. Product editor now has one Variants & Customizations section with searchable library pickers. Tablet UI enlarged across the Variants screen and modals. Product recipe rows stack properly on phones. Verified by automated smoke test for modifier-to-inventory deduction.
